name: Button/Icon-Main
description:
**Overview:** A standalone icon button without a text label.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use in toolbars, headers, or for universally understood actions (Trash, Edit).
- ❌ DO NOT use if the icon's meaning is ambiguous to users.

**Props / Variants:** Icon-Src, Size, Level, State.

**Original Notes:** Interactive elements that trigger actions, forms, or navigation.

name: Button/Icon-Flat
description:
**Overview:** A ghost icon-only button with no fill, representing the lowest visual weight in the button hierarchy.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use in toolbars, header actions, or dense UIs for secondary actions (Refresh, Filter, More options).
- ✅ Use when the action is non-critical and screen real estate is tight.
- ❌ DO NOT use for primary or destructive actions — the low contrast makes it easy to miss.
- ❌ DO NOT use if the icon meaning is ambiguous without a label.

**Props / Variants:** Icon-Src, Size, Level, State.

**Original Notes:** Interactive elements that trigger actions, forms, or navigation.

name: Button/Icon-Overlay
description:
**Overview:** An icon-only button with an overlay/filled background, offering medium contrast designed for use over images or media.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use on top of images, maps, or video players (Play, Pause, Fullscreen, Mute).
- ✅ Use as a floating action button on cards or thumbnails.
- ❌ DO NOT use as a primary CTA on a white or neutral page background.
- ❌ DO NOT use when a text label is needed — use Button/Icon-Main.

**Props / Variants:** Icon-Src, Size, Level, State.

**Original Notes:** Interactive elements that trigger actions, forms, or navigation.
